description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the correctness of asset copy and replication semantics within a database-backed asset management system. It tests copying an asset along with its input parameters, source mappings, throughput equations, scalars, and data input values, ensuring proper ID remapping, content preservation, and source asset immutability.

classes.name: DbBackedCopyReplicationCorrectnessTests
classes.description: A test suite for validating the correctness of copying assets and their associated data within the backend system, ensuring ID remapping, content integrity, and source immutability.

methods.name: Copy_asset_replicates_input_subtree_with_new_ids_and_preserves_source
methods.description: Main test method that creates a complex asset setup with parameters, mappings, scalars, and data values, copies the asset, and verifies all data is correctly replicated with new IDs while the source remains unchanged.
